effect.tenfold.marked.description: +90% damage from the Caduceus, Slowness IV, -20% damage against the wielder.
form.tenfold.greatsword.desc: Sweeps up to 3 extra foes in a wide arc.
form.tenfold.whip.desc: Long reach, pulls the target in.
form.tenfold.halfsword.desc: Block to halve damage and reflect part of it.
form.tenfold.spear.desc: Pierces everything in a straight line.
form.tenfold.cone.desc: Ignores half of the target's armor.
form.tenfold.shovel.desc: The blade has forgotten its purpose.
tooltip.tenfold.help: Right-click: issue contract · Sneak + right-click: next form · Sneak + left-click: previous form
tenfold.contract.complete: Three contracts fulfilled. Strength floods your limbs.
tenfold.contract.switch: You turned the blade elsewhere. Contract voided (no breach).
tenfold.contract.other: Wrong blood. The contract is broken.
tenfold.contract.degrade: Three breaches. The blade collapses into a shovel for %s minutes.
tenfold.locked.use: The blade refuses you for another %ss.
tenfold.advancement.root.title: Caduceus
tenfold.advancement.root.desc: Forge the blade that wears ten faces.
tenfold.advancement.issued.title: Issued
tenfold.advancement.obeyed.title: As the Contract Commands
tenfold.advancement.obeyed.desc: Complete a contract and gain Strength.
tenfold.advancement.addict.title: Contract Addict
tenfold.advancement.addict.desc: Complete four contracts back to back. You crave the next order.
tenfold.advancement.rebel.title: Contract? Never Heard of It
tenfold.advancement.rebel.desc: Break three contracts in a row.
effect.tenfold.addiction.description: +10 attack damage. You cannot refuse the next contract.
tenfold.addiction.gained: Four contracts in a row. You are addicted: +10 attack damage.
effect.tenfold.ira_release.description: Immortal; +90% damage dealt, -70% taken. Damage settles at one tenth when it ends.
item.minecraft.splash_potion.effect.ira_: Splash Potion of IRA Full Release
item.minecraft.splash_potion.effect.long: Splash Potion of IRA Full Release
item.minecraft.lingering_potion.effect.i: Lingering Potion of IRA Full Release
item.minecraft.lingering_potion.effect.l: Lingering Potion of IRA Full Release
item.tenfold.oath_shard.desc: What a tamed creature leaves behind when it falls.
item.tenfold.oath_shard.brew: Brew with an Awkward Potion in a brewing stand.
tenfold.oath.dropped: %s fell to a hostile mob, leaving its resolve behind.
tenfold.advancement.oath.title: Resolve to Protect
tenfold.advancement.oath.desc: I will surely swing my blade to protect my many companions. Whether my hopes fall short, whether I fail to save them all
tenfold.contract.breach_count: Breach %s / %s — %s more and the blade collapses.
tenfold.sniper.empty: Magazines dry — this rifle is scrap forever.
tenfold.sniper.mag_dry: This feed is empty — Shift+right-click to swap
tenfold.sniper.no_reload: No reload: all 14 rounds spent = scrap
tenfold.ammobox.armor: Grants %s armor points when worn in the chest slot
tenfold.ammobox.desc: Right-click: refill the empty sniper of a player within %s blocks (never your own)
tenfold.ammobox.help: Wear it for armor · Hold and right-click to resupply teammates
tenfold.ammobox.no_target: No other player nearby holds an empty sniper.
levandin.stage.0.desc: A longsword bound tight in iron sheet and iron chains.
levandin.stage.1.desc: The chains are gone; iron sheet still binds the blade.
levandin.stage.2.desc: The sheet is cut open — an orange edge burns beneath. Strikes set foes ablaze.
levandin.stage.3.desc: A longsword shining orange. Strikes burn foes — and sometimes the wielder too.
levandin.tooltip.self_burn: 15% chance to set yourself on fire
levandin.tooltip.help: Strike enough times, then Shift + right-click to tear off the wrapping
levandin.unwrap.need: Still wrapped tight — strike %s more time(s) first
levandin.unwrap.done: Layer %s torn away — the sword reveals form %s!
levandin.self_burn: The blade's heat crawls back onto you!
tenfold.advancement.levandin0.title: The Legendary Sword
tenfold.advancement.levandin0.desc: So what if some doubt me? That legendary sword is already in my hands!
tenfold.advancement.levandin1.title: Time to Unwrap the First Layer
tenfold.advancement.levandin1.desc: This sword, I will never get tired of it.
tenfold.advancement.levandin2.title: Open the Second Layer Too?
tenfold.advancement.levandin2.desc: Haha, interesting — so this is the feel of it.
tenfold.advancement.levandin3.title: Levandin, Full Unleash
tenfold.advancement.levandin3.desc: This will be hot. Very hot!
